claims: No Kings Day is a series of nationwide and largely peaceful protest rallies in the U.S.
No Kings Day is designed to oppose perceived authoritarianism and policies of the Trump administration.
No Kings Day draws millions across all 50 states.
No Kings Day emphasizes that the country belongs to its people rather than kings.
No Kings Day features nationwide rallies featuring protests in over 2,700 cities.
No Kings Day protests were held in October 2025.
No Kings Day protests were held in March 2026.
No Kings Day protests often target federal immigration enforcement (ICE), the cost of living, and executive actions.
The No Kings Day movement uses digital platforms to organize rallies in both major cities and smaller towns.
No Kings Day participants often wave American flags and chant against the Trump administration.
No Kings Day organizers and participants include union members such as AFSCME
